Proof in the paper: The diffraction peaks of the as-synthesized RP-LaSr3ComFe3–mO10−δ coincide well with the standard XRD pattern (i.e., PDF #81-1234) and accurately point to a layered structure with a space group of I4/mmm after incorporating various Co contents. However, the selected enlarged main peaks [region of (107) and (110) in Figure 1b] of RP-LaSr3ComFe3–mO10−δ (m = 1.0, 1.5, and 2.0) were observed to gradually shift to a higher angle upon increasing Co-substitution relative to those of the pristine RP-LaSr3Fe3O10−δ, suggesting the unit cell shrinkage due to the partial substitution of larger Fe cations (0.645 Å) by smaller Co cations (0.615 Å) at the B-site.
